text:
marta: quick ping 90min: DAST CI started failing after infra RBAC tidy. Token mint POST to token-issuer returns 403 and scan times out. tagging @kevin @sre-oncall.

kevin: saw the job. short version: ci-dast runner lost iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator relationship to token-issuer; token-issuer returns 403 so no ephemeral creds -> scanner can't reach staging.

sre-oncall: paste the actual error lines?

marta: logs from GH runner:
```
2026-06-11T08:11:02Z token-issuer: sign request denied: rpc PERMISSION_DENIED
2026-06-11T08:11:03Z dast-runner: credential fetch 403 POST https://token-issuer.internal/v1/sign
2026-06-11T08:11:04Z dast-runner: network connect ETIMEDOUT -> downstream auth failed
```

kevin: that 403 is classic SA tokenCreator gap. Which SA is set on the action?

marta: ci-dast@staging-project.iam.gserviceaccount.com (we consolidated SAs into infra-group last week).

bot-triage: ACTION: created SEC-3001 to track ephemeral grant + audit sink check.

kevin: mitigation: ephemeral grant for 30m scoped to token-issuer principal. Example cmd:
```
gcloud iam service-accounts add-iam-policy-binding ci-dast@staging-project.iam.gserviceaccount.com \\
  --member=serviceAccount:token-issuer@infra-project.iam.gserviceaccount.com \\
  --role=roles/iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator
```

sre-oncall: applied ephemeral grant at 08:28. re-run shows token-issuer returned 200 and scan proceeded. However, KMS decrypt audit entries for the flow were absent until we widened the logging sink filter.

marta: aha — during the RBAC tidy someone tightened the logging sink to drop "serviceAccount:infra-*" to reduce noise. That filter hid KMS audit evidence and made triage harder.

kevin: action items: 1) INFRA-3002 update sink to preserve cloudkms audit entries for infra principals; 2) INFRA-3003 re-add permanent tokenCreator binding but scoped to token-issuer principal + minimal resource; 3) SEC-3004 add a small GH preflight step that verifies ability to POST /v1/sign and fetch suppression files before running DAST; 4) long-term: move suppression lists into repo or use short-lived signed URLs so scan doesn't depend on a single SA ACL.

infra-admin: will open the infra tickets and leave a 1h ephemeral grant audit trail note.

marta: confirmed post-fix results: scan run completed, alerts reduced; closing here once INFRA-3002/3003 and SEC-3004 PRs are linked. Thanks :white_check_mark:
